meta.title: Action in aid of Federal Constitutional Court and Supreme Court.

versions.author: Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
versions.subject: Original Constitution 1973-08-14 Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
versions.content:
| Title        | Action in aid of Supreme Court.                                                             |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| First Added  | 14 August 1973                                                                              |
| Last Updated | 14 August 1973                                                                              |
| Source       | https://factfocus.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Original-Constitution-of-1973-Pakistan.pdf |

All executive and judicial authorities throughout Pakistan shall act in aid of the Supreme Court.

versions.author: Asif Ali Zardari
versions.subject: Twenty-seventh Amendment 2025-11-13 Asif Ali Zardari
versions.content:
| Title        | Action in aid of Federal Constitutional Court and Supreme Court.                            |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| First Added  | 14 August 1973                                                                              |
| Last Updated | 13 November 2025                                                                            |
| Source       | https://factfocus.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Original-Constitution-of-1973-Pakistan.pdf |
| Amendment 27 | https://www.senate.gov.pk/uploads/documents/1762598611_995.pdf |

All executive and judicial authorities throughout Pakistan shall act in aid of the Federal Constitutional Court and the Supreme Court.
